effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] By deleting 1 of your Digimon, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP.
[On Deletion] You may DNA digivolve 1 of your [Machinedramon] in play and 1 [Kimeramon] in the trash into [Millenniummon] in the hand.
